messages:
frank: Heads-up: seeing repeated p99 spikes on eu1 GPU rack during tenant-heavy windows. Symptoms point to SR-IOV VF churn + Flow Director rebuilds causing softirq thrash.

frank: quick excerpt from dmesg + ethtool:

frank: ```
# dmesg | tail -n 20
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: Flow director update triggered VF rebind
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: VF 3 reset on PF command
# ethtool -S enp5s0f0 | egrep 'queue|vf'
queue0_rx: 9900000
queue1_rx: 120000
vf_rule_hits: 0
```

amee: Which tenants correlate? Any repeated 5-tuple patterns?

frank: Two tenants: rt-tts (lots of short fetches) and indexer-bulk (bursty uploads). The FD rules keep regenning when rt-tts opens many ephemeral flows, which resets VF mappings and causes queue imbalance.

sasha: Short-term fix: apply per-tenant ingress policer + create a persistent FD carve for known 5-tuples so they don't churn. Medium-term: firmware homogenization + avoid mixed FD implementations on same NIC model.

cory: I pushed a quick ingress policer rule rp-sio-11 limiting new connections to 60/s for rt-tts on affected hosts and created FD carve fd-persist-77 mapping their prefixes to VF2.

infra-bot: Action: ingress-policer rp-sio-11 applied to tenant=rt-tts on hosts [eu1-node4, eu1-node5]. FD rule fd-persist-77 applied. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sriov-fd-mitigation

amee: Early telemetry? p95/p99 deltas?

frank: 4m after changes: p95 dropped 380ms -> 150ms, p99 dropped 1.05s -> 420ms. Much better but see occasional tails when indexer-bulk and rt-tts burst simultaneously.

sasha: If this repeats within the hour propose ephemeral fractional carveout (0.2) for rt-tts during their heavy window so we avoid FD churn entirely and keep other tenants unaffected. Note: warm-cache penalty ~100-300ms on first requests when moving.

cory: Cost estimate: 0.2 slice for 2h in eu-west-ish region prorated ~ +~25% marginal infra cost for that workload. Tagging billing for exact.

infra-bot: Reminder: file INC-7001 with timeline & attach perf graphs. :memo:

frank: Filed INC-7001 and tagged billing + acct team. Keeping policer + FD carve for now. Will escalate to ephemeral carveout if p99 exceeds 600ms again. Thanks. :thumbsup:
